info.description: ONE CARD on /academics/class-corner/. ⚠⚠ THE DOCUMENTS ARE HELD HERE NOW, NOT LINKED FROM THE SCHOOL'S OLD SITE. They used to point at sunbeamballia.edu.in/wp-content/uploads/…, which meant a parent left this site to read them and the school had to maintain two places. Upload the new file over `file` and the card serves it — no developer, no deploy. ⚠ THE TRADE THAT COMES WITH THAT: a linked file was always whatever the school had just published; a held file is whatever was last uploaded HERE. If the office revises a timetable or a monitors list, it has to be uploaded here too, or this page quietly serves last session's.

body.description: One line saying what the document is. Not school copy — this site's label for it.

order.description: Card order on the page. Lower first.

file.description: The document itself — a PDF or an image. LEAVE EMPTY and fill `link` instead where the card should open a page on this site.

link.description: A route on THIS site, e.g. /academics/class-corner/class-timetable/. Use instead of `file`, never as well. ⚠ NEVER PUT AN http:// ADDRESS HERE — the point of this content type is that the school's documents stop living somewhere else.

pending.description: Set ONLY where the school has not published the thing yet. The card then renders as plainly unfinished — flat, dashed, not clickable — instead of looking like a card whose link failed.

needs.description: What is still owed, ONE PER LINE, shown as chips on a pending card. ⚠ NAME MISSING THINGS, NEVER VALUES — 'name', never 'Mr X'. A real value here stops being a placeholder and becomes a claim the school has not made.
